ache.title: Tier lists by focus: now your account can feel ‘behind’
ache.note: Ranking Star Rail characters by account focus, to show which ones deserve “more attention,” sounds helpful. But a tierlist quietly turns your roster into a report card, and the low marks start to itch. And “v. 2.1” means it goes stale next patch. Your account isn’t behind. It’s yours, built from characters you actually like.
watch: your roster graded by a tierlist
ache.tip: Use a tierlist to play what you own better, never as a list of what to pull next.
lines: a tierlist is a mood, not a verdict
v2.1 already. it expires like milk

title: Skill Point Focus Tierlist (v. 2.1) | Honkai: Star Rail
excerpt: Stemming from the popular "Account Building" video about character foci, I decided to make a tierlist based on each one of them, to help you understand which character to put more attention on, based on the focus or foci your account is around!
